segments.text:
V. 1.
After theſe things Jeſus walled in Galilee—That is, continued there, for ſome Months after the Second Paſſover: For he would not walk—Continue in Judea; becauſe the Jews—Thoſe of them who did not believe; and in particular the chief Prieſts, Scribes, and Phariſees, ſought an Opportunity to kill him.
